record_title: Sharp curvature-range envelopes and a minimax weight for symmetric three-point rules
provenance: A sharp optimization of the endpoint-midpoint second-derivative identity and parameter bounds in Simić and Bin-Mohsin (2021), with explicit separation from older sharp Simpson coverage.
limitations: The theorem concerns the symmetric endpoint-midpoint family and curvature extrema only; sharp nonconstant-curvature profiles are generally approached rather than attained in C2. Simpson-specific 1/162 sharpness is prior-covered. Equivalent older general three-point quadrature coverage in different notation cannot be excluded. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
